SMART GOAL • EVIDENCE-INFORMED PLANNING

SMART GOAL

Dashboard rekomendasi membership + PT yang menggabungkan data tubuh, frekuensi latihan, jadwal mingguan, estimasi energi aktivitas, dan prinsip latihan dari ACSM, NASM, serta WHO.

TARGET GUIDE
0.5 kg / week*

1. Client Profile & Goal Input

Semua data dapat dimasukkan manual. Kolom BMI, BMR, WHR, fat mass/fat % dapat diisi dari hasil assessment.

Tidak tahu 1RM? Hitung dari beban & reps terakhir (rumus Epley):
Target-body guide: SMART GOAL will show a WHO BMI reference weight range and, when body-fat %/mass is available, a NASM-style target-weight calculation that preserves lean mass. “Ideal” muscle mass is not a universal ACSM/NASM/WHO kg cutoff, so the dashboard treats current skeletal muscle as a baseline to preserve/increase and reports the change target transparently.

2. Weekly Training Day Setup

Pilih hari PT. Hari PT menggunakan planning model Anda: sampai 700 kcal per sesi. Sistem akan otomatis menandai hari berikutnya sebagai EPOC 105 kcal bila memungkinkan.

3. Non-PT Activity Recommendation

Pilih treadmill, class, swimming, yoga, pilates, atau recovery. Durasi dapat diubah manual; estimasi kcal memakai model MET × berat badan × waktu.

Intensity guide: ACSM describes moderate aerobic work around RPE 3–4/10 and vigorous work around RPE 5–7/10; the talk test can also be used. WHO recommends adults accumulate 150–300 min/week moderate aerobic activity (or 75–150 min vigorous) plus muscle-strengthening on ≥2 days/week.
Framework: 1 kg = 7,700 kcal is the planning constant requested for this application. The 700 kcal PT-day and 15% EPOC/105 kcal assumptions are your business-planning assumptions, not ACSM/NASM/WHO guarantees. Activity calorie values are estimates from MET-based energy-expenditure modeling; individual expenditure varies.

Assessment & Health Recommendation

Isi usia untuk melihat THR
Framework: WHO physical activity guidance, ACSM exercise testing/prescription principles, NASM OPT concepts and international literature. Screening outputs are support tools, not diagnosis or medical treatment.
FITNESS TESTING • BASELINE • PROGRESS

FIT TEST

START FIT TEST →

Client Fit Test

Input manual hasil tes. Sistem tidak mengarang hasil yang belum diukur.

Testing principle: keep test protocol consistent at retest. ACSM organizes fitness assessment around body composition, cardiorespiratory fitness, muscular fitness and flexibility; NASM uses movement assessment to identify movement compensations and guide programming. WHO provides population physical-activity targets.

Standards & interpretation framework

ACSM

Health-related fitness is interpreted across body composition, cardiorespiratory fitness, muscular fitness and flexibility. Test selection and protocol should match the client and testing context.

NASM

Movement screening looks for compensations, mobility/stability limitations and neuromuscular control issues that can inform exercise selection and progression.

WHO

For adults, the population target is 150–300 min/week moderate aerobic activity (or 75–150 vigorous) plus muscle-strengthening on 2+ days/week.

Primary references: ACSM Fitness Assessment Manual (6e) / ACSM Guidelines for Exercise Testing and Prescription (11e); NASM Overhead Squat Assessment and movement-assessment framework; WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour.

Personal Trainer Program

Goal-specific programming with load, resistance, sets, reps, rest, RPE/RIR, volume and progression.

Opsional — isi beban kerja aktual (bukan harus 1RM) yang baru saja diselesaikan member untuk pola gerak terkait. Estimasi 1RM (rumus Epley) akan langsung muncul di bawah kolom Reps begitu kedua nilai diisi, dan dipakai untuk mempersonalisasi rekomendasi beban per exercise — bukan lagi hanya estimasi generik dari berat badan. Kosongkan jika belum ada data.

Program terstruktur berbasis pola gerak dasar: squat, push, pull, hinge, carry/core — model paling scientific untuk progres jangka panjang.
